summary_1line: A grieving Brahmin brings his dead son to Rama’s palace, blaming the king’s possible unrighteousness for the unnatural death.

image_candidates.scene_text: An old Brahmin stands at Rama’s palace gate holding the lifeless body of his young son while crying out in anguish before the guards.
The grieving father lifts the child toward the palace, accusing King Rama’s rule as the cause of the boy’s untimely death.
